size_authority.status: Naica's 11-12 m selenite beams are individual crystals. Satin-spar fiber packs and desert-rose rosettes are aggregate habits with no universal record extent and are capacity-bound.

Handbook documents elongated crystals to 45 cm; Royal Ontario Museum reference text reports Put-in-Bay geode crystals as wide as 46 cm. The cap is twice the 46 cm individual authority. Fibrous blankets/nodules are aggregate extents and capacity-bound.
